expr.reason: The resolver is an OpenAPI vocabulary over @tabnas/expr's tree layer (key operators and fold), which exists in TypeScript only. The maintainer instructed the TypeScript dependency on 2026-11-09 so that Phase 2 builds on expr's main ahead of the layer's release.
expr.repair: Go and Rust take expr when they port the resolver, after expr's Go and Rust ports of the tree layer (the plan's Phase E); then this entry is deleted.
